errors.text: The 600 K state is described as having high, stable dislocation density, whereas the target attributes the increased elastic modulus at 600 K to reduced dislocation density.
The proposed amorphous shear-banding, magneto-volume, and sharply increased stacking-fault-energy pathway is not established for the simulated FeNiCrCoCu/Cu system by the cited evidence.
Pre-straining does not ensure that dislocation density remains high during a 1200 K indentation, so the proposed control does not cleanly isolate disorder from dislocation annihilation.
